summary.plain: The worldwide team running the Belle II experiment in Japan: more than 1100 scientists and engineers from 122 institutions in 27 countries.
summary.technical: International collaboration formed around 2010 with the Belle II Technical Design Report; operates the Belle II detector at SuperKEKB, with 122 member institutions in 27 countries as listed by the collaboration in September 2026.
